name: relay-workspace
description: Human and AI agent collaboration with a shared local workspace

scripts.build: npm run build -w relay-core && npm run build -w relay-daemon && npm run build -w relay-tui && npm run build -w web && tsc -p packages/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:py
scripts.test:ts: npm run build && node --test dist/packages/relay-core/tests/handoff.test.js dist/packages/relay-daemon/tests/cli.test.js dist/packages/relay-daemon/tests/daemon.test.js dist/packages/relay-tui/tests/tui.test.js dist/web/tests/status.test.js dist/web/tests/adminHelpers.test.js dist/web/tests/agentStream.test.js dist/web/tests/messageRouting.test.js
scripts.test:py: UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project backend --extra dev pytest
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && UV_CACHE_DIR=.uv-cache uv run --project backend --extra dev pytest -m integration
